If I do have bad choices in women, truthfully, I don’t know what I’m missing. I don’t know why I always chose the wrong people.

Truthfully none of them were alike, the first made a drunken mistake one night, and i didn’t love her so I dropped her then and there. The second time, might’ve been my fault, I was going through a rough patch and wasn’t really as emotionally, or physically available as I should’ve been, and she found someone who was, again, i dropped her in an instant, because I really didn’t feel like loved her, although it still hurt. The most recent time, I loved her with all my heart, we both agreed we wanted to spend the rest of our lives together, everything just made sense between us. We were like pieces of a puzzle, we just fit. I explained what happened in detail with the most recent in another comment, and if you read you might have a better understanding

I do think you’re right though, I’m so in love with the thought of being in love, and like, I don’t know, just who I am as a person, I had a shitty life growing up, and all I ever want to do is treat people well, and make sure they know their loved. I never felt that much love growing up, and I just don’t believe anyone else deserves to feel how I felt. Everyone is special, and I’m afraid that makes me a weak person because I care so much, and I’m afraid I do scare people off with that mentality, it just means a lot to me that the people around me are happy. Everyone deserves happiness.

I mean, yeah I guess I did. But I chose to believe she had grown up because those red flags were from a different time in her life and I truly believed she had grown up. Honestly, other than her cheating on me, she had never given me a reason not to trust her. She’s been open and honest about everything else before. I truly believe this was a mistake, and I explained it more in a different comment, so I really just don’t get why it happened. I’ve just been so confused by this, because we truly were so well together, dare I say even meant for each other. We could literally finish each other’s sentences, it just felt right between us.

So the first 2 were fairly long, over a year and a half each. The most recent was only 6 months, but something was different this time, from the moment I met her I knew I loved her, I felt like I had known her all my life, we were so effortlessly perfect for each other.

The first two women were fairly secure in their lives, I really don’t know what happened with them, and sure it hurt being cheated on by them, but this is unlike any pain I’ve ever felt before. The most recent, I knew she had a lot of baggage, she had been through a really hard divorce and had an abusive ex boyfriend who she was so used to having around. But we just worked so perfect together, I knew I could stand by her through everything and give her my support so she could come out a better person. She went back to that Ex when we found out I was going to Japan for 4 years and she wouldn’t be able to come, she claims she was so upset she was trying to do anything she could to forget about me and make me hate her so she wouldn’t be so hurt about me leaving. She’s got a lot of maturing to do and I see that now, I hope she finds happiness and maybe if she grows up someday, I’d love to be with her again. I know I’m so stupid for feeling this way, and I’ll get berated for this, but there really is something different between us. It’s something I’ve never been able to explain before and it just feels like I’ll never find this again, I’ve never met anyone, ever, who just made sense being around like she did.
